newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BATISTUTA FAILS TO RETURN TO FIORENTINA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BATISTUTA FAILS TO RETURN TO FIORENTINA.

text.p: Fiorentina's unsettled Argentine striker Gabriel Batistuta failed to return to Italy from Buenos Aires for a pre-season team meeting on Thursday.

Batistuta, who has said he wants to play in Spain next season and has been linked to both Barcelona and Real Madrid, was due to join the rest of the Fiorentina side ahead of a two-week training session starting on Sunday.
But his agent reportedly said he was sick and irritable and would stay in the Argentine capital for a few more days.
"He doesn't feel well," Settimio Aloisio was quoted on the Italian news agency ANSA as telling reporters in Buenos Aires. "He's hardly touched his food and he's been to see a doctor.
"Gabriel's not used to this type of tension. He's irritable, he's suffering like I've never seen him suffer before.
"We need to find a solution to this anxious situation for Gabriel. I'm sure we'll find a solution that's good for both him and for Fiorentina."
Batistuta appeared set to join Barcelona at the end of last month but the Catalan side reportedly baulked at Fiorentina's $23.8 million price tag. He was subsequently linked to Real Madrid.
